items.title: Noether normalization over a domain, up to inverting one element of the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that an injective finite type map over a domain factors through a polynomial algebra over which the next algebra is finite, up to inverting one nonzero element of the base (statement lines 28342-28351). The proof normalizes the generic fibre, then clears the finitely many denominators in the integrality relations to produce the intermediate algebra and a single element of the base after which the factorisation becomes an isomorphism (proof lines 28353-28378). Clearing denominators uniformly so that one element suffices is the step that carries the argument. H2.
